card.name: Words just before a named comparison group
card.fires_on: Words like "another", "other", "exposures" or "to" that come right before a reference to a related drug, drug class or item. Most often seen in contraindication and interaction text.

modes.label: another/other before a drug class
modes.description: The word "another" or "other" introduces a second drug or class of the same kind.
modes.example: Do not use almotriptan tablets within 24 hours of an ergotamine-containing, or ergot-type medication, or of<< another>> 5-HT 1 agonist,

modes.label: Word before a named drug
modes.description: A noun or preposition such as "exposures" or "to" sits just before the naming of a specific drug or class.
modes.example: clinically significant adverse reactions from higher<< exposures>> of TYBOST and atazan

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model for a demonstrative-style reference to a group or set, but the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on small words that lead into a second drug or drug class, such as "other" or "another" in warnings.
